question: If 20% of a number is added to 60, then the result is the same number. 75% of the same number is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

20% of number + 60 = number

⇒ 80% of number = 60

⇒ Number = 60 ÷ 0.8 = 75

75% of number = 0.75 × 75 = 56.25

**∴ The correct answer = 56.25**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number + 60 = number

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Value ÷ 100) × Number

 
 

 **Expression**
 **Value**
 
 

 Number
 x
 
 

 20% of x
 0.2x
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 0.2x + 60 = x

⇒ x − 0.2x = 60

⇒ 0.8x = 60

⇒ x = 75

⇒ 75% of x = 0.75 × 75 = 56.25

**∴ The correct answer is 56.25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Basics

20% = 1/5 and 75% = 3/4

Equation Formation

Translate statements into algebraic equations

Shortcut Logic

If x − 20% of x = constant, then remaining % = constant
